name: invoice-review-note
title: Invoice review note
for_each: select id,name from invoices where status in ('received','in-review','adjusted','rejected')

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select q.name as invoice,q.firm,q.matter_number,q.currency,q.total,q.reductions,q.status from invoice_queue q where q.id=$1
sections.note: Draft for the reviewing lawyer. Check each reduction against the engagement terms before it goes to the firm.

sections.title: Reductions
sections.sql: select line_no,item_date,timekeeper_name,amount,reduction,reduction_reason from line_items where invoice_id=$1 and reduction>0 order by line_no

sections.title: Guideline checks
sections.sql: select line_no,timekeeper_name,rule,at_stake from line_flags where invoice_id=$1 order by line_no,rule

sections.title: Budget position
sections.note: Forecast is approved plus pending invoices plus this month's accrual.

sections.title: Invoices
sections.sql: select name,status,invoice_date,currency,total,approved_amount from invoices where matter_id=$1 order by invoice_date

sections.title: Accruals for finance
sections.sql: select name,matter_number,firm,this_month,last_month,basis from accrual_status where period=$1::date order by firm,name
sections.note: Estimates of work done and not yet billed, as recorded by the legal team. Blank rows still need an estimate from the firm.

sections.title: By business unit
sections.sql: select coalesce(m.business_unit,'Unallocated') as business_unit,sum(a.amount) as accrued from accruals a join matters m on m.id=a.matter_id where a.period=$1::date group by 1 order by 1
